steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Next.js 15 foundation, env validation, Supabase proxy/client scaffold, Vitest, Dockerfile, health endpoint, and landing page added.
steps.known_issues: Docker CLI is not installed or not on PATH, so `docker build -t workshop-agent .` was not verified. Current Node is v24.14.1 while the project standard is Node 20 LTS.

steps.name: db-schema
steps.summary: Initial Supabase schema, guarded seed data, manual domain/Supabase types, and schema coverage tests added.
steps.known_issues: `npx supabase db reset` could not complete because Docker Desktop/daemon is unavailable on this machine. SQL was statically verified by tests, but local PostgreSQL application remains unverified until Docker is available.

steps.name: auth-invite
steps.summary: Facilitator auth APIs/UI, signed participant sessions, rate limiting, project/workshop APIs, invite preview/join flow, dashboard screens, workshop shell, and security/unit tests added.
steps.known_issues: `npx supabase db reset` still cannot run because Docker Desktop/daemon is unavailable. The join RPC migration is covered by static tests but has not been applied to a local PostgreSQL instance.

steps.name: workshop-crud
steps.summary: Workshop detail/update/delete APIs, stage transition rules, settings guards, stale dismissal, process graph CRUD APIs, editing lock APIs, Zustand workshop/process graph stores, Realtime provider, StageNav, ParticipantList, ErrorBoundary, and React Flow context shell added.
steps.known_issues: Supabase local db reset remains unverified because Docker Desktop/daemon is unavailable. Context graph UI is a functional shell; detailed node editing panels and auto-layout controls are deferred to later context-editor hardening.

steps.name: realtime-board
steps.summary: Gather-stage notes APIs, note permission/stage-lock tests, boardStore Realtime sync, y-supabase/Yjs adapter, yjs_documents migration, tldraw canvas shell, sticky note toolbar/cards with optimistic DB sync, notes Realtime subscription, and gather-stage workshop UI integration added.
steps.known_issues: Supabase local db reset and multi-tab Yjs behavior remain unverified because Docker Desktop/daemon is unavailable. The current tldraw integration renders the canvas and overlays canonical DB-backed sticky notes; full custom tldraw shape serialization can be hardened later without changing the notes API contract.

steps.name: ai-clustering
steps.summary: Azure OpenAI clustering client, clustering prompts, Zod AI response validation, retryable AI helper, processing stale-lock helper, /api/ai/cluster, clusters list/patch APIs, clusterStore, ClusterView/ClusterGroup UI, and clusters Realtime subscription added.
steps.known_issues: Live Azure OpenAI and Supabase DB application were not verified because this environment has restricted network access and Docker Desktop/daemon remains unavailable. AI behavior is covered with mocked completion tests and build-time integration checks.

steps.name: dot-voting
steps.summary: Vote create/delete/list APIs, vote results and participation stats APIs, vote policy helpers/tests, voteStore, DotVoting/VotingCard/VoteResult UI, results reveal control, votes Realtime subscription, and vote-stage workshop UI integration added.
steps.known_issues: Realtime and DB constraints were not exercised against a live Supabase instance because Docker Desktop/daemon remains unavailable. Result visibility and vote aggregation are covered by unit tests and build-time integration.
